game_events.label: Overtime, shootout, multi-OT, BTTS, first goal and early goal
game_events.target: Event occurrence in the game: reaches overtime/shootout/multiple overtimes, both teams score, which team scores first, or an early goal within a time window.

game_moneyline_puckline.label: Game winner, regulation winner, puck line and win margin
game_moneyline_puckline.target: Which team wins (including OT/SO or regulation only), covers a goal spread, or wins by a given margin.

game_total_and_team_total.label: Game total goals and team totals
game_total_and_team_total.target: Whether total goals (or a team's goals) in the game exceed a threshold under the contract's period and OT scope.

goalie_saves.label: Goalie saves thresholds
goalie_saves.target: Whether a goalie records at least k saves; eligibility conditional on the goalie playing per the wording.

offfield_markets.label: Non-hockey and office/personnel markets
offfield_markets.target: Event in the league or organization outside the game (transactions, announcements, business questions).

parlay_combo.label: Parlay / combo contracts
parlay_combo.target: Joint outcome of multiple legs (team results, totals, player stats) in one contract.

period_markets.label: Period winner, total, spread and both-teams-to-score
period_markets.target: Outcome within a single 20-minute period (winner including tie handling, goal total, spread, or both teams scoring).

player_h2h.label: Player head-to-head comparisons
player_h2h.target: Whether player A records more of a stat (points, shots, saves) than player B, with tie and DNP rules per the contract.

player_points_goals_assists.label: Skater goals / assists / points thresholds
player_points_goals_assists.target: Whether a skater records at least k goals, assists or points in the game (typically 1+, 2+, 3+), subject to the contract's DNP rule.

player_shots_on_goal.label: Skater shots on goal thresholds
player_shots_on_goal.target: Whether a skater records at least k official shots on goal in the game.

season_awards_and_stats.label: Season awards and season player stat leaders
season_awards_and_stats.target: Winners of league awards (Hart, Vezina, Norris, Calder, etc.) or leaders/totals for season player stats.

season_futures.label: Championship, division/conference and playoff series futures
season_futures.target: Team wins the Cup, a conference/division, qualifies, or wins a playoff series.

unreg:draft_selection.label: NHL draft selections (top pick and draft slot)
unreg:draft_selection.target: Which player or team is selected at a given draft position, determined by the league's lottery and team decisions.

unreg:playoff_series_aggregate.label: NHL playoff series aggregate outcomes (series total goals and related series-length props)
unreg:playoff_series_aggregate.target: A quantity added up across one best-of-7 playoff series (e.g. total goals in all games) compared with a threshold. Its value depends jointly on the number of games played (4-7) and on scoring in each game.

unreg:team_and_player_season_counting.label: NHL season point/goal totals and counting leaders
unreg:team_and_player_season_counting.target: A player's season total (goals, points) or team points relative to a threshold.

r20_000.rules_primary: If Carolina and Vegas go to double overtime in the Carolina vs Vegas professional hockey game originally scheduled for Jun 14, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

r20_001.rules_primary: If at least 5 games go to overtime in the Vegas Golden Knights vs Carolina Hurricanes Stanley Cup® Finals Series in the 2026 NHL Playoffs, then the market resolves to Yes.

r20_002.rules_primary: If Florida wins 4-3 in the 2025 Pro Hockey Championship series, then the market resolves to Yes.
